regions.name: Raga, Western Bahr el Ghazal State, South Sudan

sensor: Aqua MODIS 2003-2022, NOAA-20 VIIRS 375 m on the Aqua scale from 2023 and for the last 30 days; confidence filter as the record, static sources removed

validation.note: Aqua counts in the held-out year's two 30-day windows, predicted from NOAA-20 alone. The flag test asks whether 'above normal' is called for the same cells from NOAA-20 as from Aqua's own counts.

rule: 30-day outlook per 0.5° cell on the Aqua MODIS scale: Aqua MODIS for 2003 to the year before its measured drift onset, NOAA-20 VIIRS on the Aqua scale after it and for the last 30 days (a per-cell ratio of totals fitted while both observed before the drift, shrunk toward the worldwide ratio), so it does not need Aqua. season: the next 30 days usually bring at least 5 hotspots (median of earlier years). above: the last 30 days are at or above the 90th percentile of the same days in earlier years and at least 5 hotspots. watch: both at once. rising: the usual next 30 days are at least twice the usual last 30.
caveat: Climatological outlook: what the next 30 days usually bring, and how unusual the last 30 days were against the same days since 2003. Not a forecast of weather or fire, and not an official alert. Hotspots are satellite detections, not confirmed fires; recent days are near-real-time. Years from Aqua's drift onset and the last 30 days come from NOAA-20 VIIRS put on the Aqua scale with a per-cell ratio, so the outlook carries on when Aqua is switched off; the ratio's held-out error is in `validation`. For one area, its harmonized record (all five satellites) is the reference.
